Composition: Show the compact pink-and-gray Sleeping Beauty Castle with blue conical roofs, its central arched passage and lowered drawbridge spanning the moat. Keep the familiar low wide castle silhouette complete, with a short flower border and no character costumes or signage.

Style: Use the attached invidious.png for drawing style only. Match its thick rounded dark-brown contours, simplified rounded shapes, and restrained 2D cartoon shading. Do not copy the reference subject or composition.

Framing: One compact composition, with the complete subject using about 80-90% of the square. Keep everything inside the frame.

Output: 512x512 PNG, RGBA, genuine transparent background. No text, numerals, labels, logos or watermark.
Critical architecture and emblem constraints: the castle is LOW and WIDE, not a tall Cinderella Castle. Its total building width is about twice its building height. The front entrance has a plain blank stone shield with absolutely no Mickey silhouette, symbols or logos. Keep the modest central spire and asymmetrical smaller turrets of Anaheim Sleeping Beauty Castle.
en: Disneyland is represented by Sleeping Beauty Castle, its blue roofs, moat, and lowered drawbridge.
